units.source_text: 正好在驹子送岛村到车站的时候，叶子赶来告诉她：病人不行了，要接她回去。

en.t: Just as Komako was seeing Shimamura off at the station, Yoko came to tell her that the patient was failing and that she had come to take Komako back.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，驹子坚决不肯回去。

en.t: Even so, Komako firmly refused to go back.

units.source_text: 因此，好像临终也没有见一面。

en.t: Because of that, it seems she did not even see him at the end.

units.source_text: 由于曾经发生过这种事，岛村越发记住那个叫行男的男人了。

en.t: Because something like that had happened, Shimamura remembered the man named Yukio all the more clearly.
